title: Semilinear open sections with literal restriction evaluation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$, with its coefficient and operation presentation [def-sf-integral-open-operations]. For the strict finite coefficient sheaves and their transitions on the pro-etale site [def-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison-data], there exists a semilinear derived sections calculus [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] whose localization at the actual open object $j$ has restriction evaluation equal to the identity on every underlying section, for each positive coefficient level. Site and coefficient universes are independent.

source.place: Tags 03DI--03DJ, with the normalized open-localization clause of lem-pur-system-block-repetition

proof.text: Choose the existing semilinear derived sections calculus. Apply the normalized open-extension clause of system block repetition to the identity block map at each open V. Retain its first open-localization package O(V) and its identity-on-sections restriction evaluation. Choose this family and replace the localization field of the chosen calculus by O, leaving all other fields unchanged. The localization field has no coherence requirements with the geometric or scalar fields, so this record update is well typed. At the specified open its evaluation is the chosen normalized package. The identity block map has finite singleton fibers, including index zero; the construction also applies to the empty and identity opens.
